checks.name: CK_CuaHang_ToaDo
checks.definition:
(ViDo IS NULL AND KinhDo IS NULL) OR
        (ViDo IS NOT NULL AND KinhDo IS NOT NULL AND
         ViDo BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND KinhDo BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

checks.name: CK_HopDong_HinhThucKy
checks.definition:
HinhThucKy IS NULL
            OR HinhThucKy IN ('DIEN_TU','MAN_HINH','BAN_GIAY')

checks.name: CK_HopDong_ThongTinKy
checks.definition:
TrangThai IN ('CHO_KY','DA_HUY')
            OR (NgayKy IS NOT NULL AND HinhThucKy IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_ChiTietHopDong_NgayNhan
checks.definition:
NgayNhanThucTe IS NULL
            OR NgayGiaoThucTe IS NULL
            OR NgayNhanThucTe >= NgayGiaoThucTe

checks.name: CK_ChiTietHopDong_ReturnInspection
checks.definition: (KetQuaKiemTra IS NULL OR KetQuaKiemTra IN('CHUA_KIEM_TRA','DAT','CO_VAN_DE')) AND (LoaiNgoaiLeNhanTra IS NULL OR LoaiNgoaiLeNhanTra IN('THIEU_THIET_BI','BAO_MAT')) AND (KetQuaKiemTra<>'DAT' OR (CoHuHong=0 AND ThieuPhuKien=0))

checks.name: CK_QuyetToanHopDong_Money
checks.definition: TienThue>=0 AND PhiGiaHan>=0 AND PhiTraTre>=0 AND BoiThuong>=0 AND ThuePhiDaThu>=0 AND CocDaThu>=0 AND CocKhauTru>=0 AND CocKhauTru<=CocDaThu AND ConPhaiThuBanDau>=0 AND HoanCocBanDau>=0 AND HoanKhacBanDau>=0 AND TongNghiaVu=TienThue+PhiGiaHan+PhiTraTre+BoiThuong AND ThuePhiDaThu+CocDaThu+ConPhaiThuBanDau=TongNghiaVu+HoanCocBanDau+HoanKhacBanDau

checks.name: CK_PhanBoQuyetToan_Kind
checks.definition: LoaiNghiaVu IN('TIEN_THUE','PHI_GIA_HAN','TRA_TRE','BOI_THUONG') AND (DonGia IS NULL OR DonGia>=0) AND (SoNgay IS NULL OR SoNgay>=0)

checks.name: CK_PhanBoQuyetToan_Line
checks.definition: (LoaiDong='NGHIA_VU' AND SoTien>=0 AND MaNghiaVu IS NULL AND MaThanhToan IS NULL) OR (LoaiDong='PHAN_BO' AND SoTien>0 AND MaNghiaVu IS NOT NULL AND MaThanhToan IS NOT NULL AND Id<>MaNghiaVu)

checks.name: CK_DanhGia_TrangThaiKiemDuyet
checks.definition: TrangThaiKiemDuyet IS NULL OR TrangThaiKiemDuyet IN ('CONG_KHAI','AN','CHO_DUYET','DA_DUYET','TU_CHOI')

checks.name: CKR_KhachThue_EmailProof
checks.definition: EmailXacMinhLucUtc IS NULL OR (Email IS NOT NULL AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(Email)))>0)

checks.name: CKR_ThanhToan_RefundStaff
checks.definition: (NguoiXacNhanHoan IS NULL AND XacNhanHoanLucUtc IS NULL) OR (NguoiXacNhanHoan IS NOT NULL AND XacNhanHoanLucUtc IS NOT NULL AND LoaiThanhToan IN ('HOAN_COC','HOAN_TIEN_THUE','HOAN_THU_THUA') AND TrangThai='DA_HOAN')

checks.name: CKR_ThanhToan_RefundRecorded
checks.definition: LoaiThanhToan NOT IN ('HOAN_COC','HOAN_TIEN_THUE','HOAN_THU_THUA') OR TrangThai<>'DA_HOAN' OR (NguoiXacNhanHoan IS NOT NULL AND XacNhanHoanLucUtc IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CKR_ThanhToan_RefundOwner
checks.definition: (NguoiXacNhanNhanHoan IS NULL AND KhachXacNhanNhanHoanLucUtc IS NULL) OR (NguoiXacNhanNhanHoan IS NOT NULL AND KhachXacNhanNhanHoanLucUtc IS NOT NULL AND XacNhanHoanLucUtc IS NOT NULL AND NguoiXacNhanHoan IS NOT NULL AND KhachXacNhanNhanHoanLucUtc>=XacNhanHoanLucUtc AND LoaiThanhToan IN ('HOAN_COC','HOAN_TIEN_THUE','HOAN_THU_THUA') AND TrangThai='DA_HOAN')

checks.name: CKR_PhieuPhat_Actor
checks.definition: (TrangThai='CHO_XAC_NHAN' AND NguoiXuLy IS NULL AND XuLyLucUtc IS NULL) OR (TrangThai IN ('DA_XAC_NHAN','DA_THANH_TOAN','HUY') AND NguoiXuLy IS NOT NULL AND XuLyLucUtc IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK33_HopDong_TrangThaiNhanTra
checks.definition: TrangThaiNhanTra IS NULL OR TrangThaiNhanTra IN ('DANG_KIEM_TRA','DA_KIEM_TRA','NGOAI_LE')

checks.name: CK33_BienBanNhanTra_Inspection
checks.definition: (KiemTraLucUtc IS NULL AND NguoiKiemTra IS NULL) OR (KiemTraLucUtc IS NOT NULL AND NguoiKiemTra IS NOT NULL AND ThucNhanLuc IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK33_BienBanNhanTra_LastCorrection
checks.definition: (ThucNhanLucTruocSua IS NULL AND NguoiSuaThucNhan IS NULL AND SuaThucNhanLucUtc IS NULL AND LyDoSuaThucNhan IS NULL) OR (ThucNhanLucTruocSua IS NOT NULL AND NguoiSuaThucNhan IS NOT NULL AND SuaThucNhanLucUtc IS NOT NULL AND LyDoSuaThucNhan IS NOT NULL AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(LyDoSuaThucNhan)))>0 AND ThucNhanLuc IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK33_QuyetToanHopDong_NoRefundAck
checks.definition: (KhachXacNhanHoanTatLucUtc IS NULL AND NguoiXacNhanHoanTat IS NULL) OR (KhachXacNhanHoanTatLucUtc IS NOT NULL AND NguoiXacNhanHoanTat IS NOT NULL AND HoanCocBanDau+HoanKhacBanDau=0 AND KhachXacNhanHoanTatLucUtc>=ChotLucUtc)

checks.name: CK33_DoiSoatHuyHopDong_Actor
checks.definition: LoaiTacNhanHuy IN ('KHACH_HANG','NHAN_VIEN','ADMIN','HE_THONG') AND ((LoaiTacNhanHuy='HE_THONG' AND NguoiHuy IS NULL) OR (LoaiTacNhanHuy<>'HE_THONG' AND NguoiHuy IS NOT NULL)) AND LoaiHuy IN ('KHACH_HUY','KHONG_DEN','CUA_HANG_HUY','HET_HAN_KY') AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(LyDoHuy)))>0 AND DoiSoatHuyLucUtc>=HuyLucUtc

checks.name: CK33_DoiSoatHuyHopDong_Money
checks.definition: TyLeKhauTruHuy IN (0,0.30,1) AND TienCocDaThuKhiHuy>=0 AND TienThueDaThuKhiHuy>=0 AND TienThuThuaDaThuKhiHuy>=0 AND TienKhauTruHuy>=0 AND TienCocPhaiHoanKhiHuy>=0 AND TienThuePhaiHoanKhiHuy>=0 AND TienThuThuaPhaiHoanKhiHuy>=0 AND TienKhauTruHuy=ROUND(TienCocDaThuKhiHuy*TyLeKhauTruHuy,2) AND TienCocPhaiHoanKhiHuy=TienCocDaThuKhiHuy-TienKhauTruHuy AND TienThuePhaiHoanKhiHuy=TienThueDaThuKhiHuy AND TienThuThuaPhaiHoanKhiHuy=TienThuThuaDaThuKhiHuy AND (LoaiHuy NOT IN ('CUA_HANG_HUY','HET_HAN_KY') OR TyLeKhauTruHuy=0)

checks.name: CK33_DoiSoatHuyHopDong_UnsignedExpiry
checks.definition: LoaiHuy<>'HET_HAN_KY' OR (TienCocDaThuKhiHuy=0 AND TienThueDaThuKhiHuy=0 AND TienThuThuaDaThuKhiHuy=0 AND TienKhauTruHuy=0 AND TienCocPhaiHoanKhiHuy=0 AND TienThuePhaiHoanKhiHuy=0 AND TienThuThuaPhaiHoanKhiHuy=0)

checks.name: CK33_DoiSoatHuyHopDong_NoShowReason
checks.definition: LoaiHuy<>'KHONG_DEN' OR LyDoHuy=N'Khách không đến nhận bàn giao thiết bị'

checks.name: CK33_DoiSoatHuyHopDong_NoShowRate
checks.definition: LoaiHuy<>'KHONG_DEN' OR TyLeKhauTruHuy=1 OR (TyLeKhauTruHuy=0 AND CanCuNgoaiLeHuy IS NOT NULL AND CanCuNgoaiLeHuy IN ('BAT_KHA_KHANG','LOI_CUA_HANG'))

checks.name: CK33_DoiSoatHuyHopDong_Exception
checks.definition: (CanCuNgoaiLeHuy IS NULL AND LyDoNgoaiLeHuy IS NULL) OR (CanCuNgoaiLeHuy IS NOT NULL AND CanCuNgoaiLeHuy IN ('BAT_KHA_KHANG','LOI_CUA_HANG') AND LyDoNgoaiLeHuy IS NOT NULL AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(LyDoNgoaiLeHuy)))>0 AND TyLeKhauTruHuy=0 AND (CanCuNgoaiLeHuy<>'BAT_KHA_KHANG' OR LoaiTacNhanHuy='ADMIN'))

checks.name: CK33_ThanhToan_RefundContext
checks.definition: (MaDoiSoatHuyHopDong IS NULL AND ((MaQuyetToan IS NULL AND LoaiThanhToan NOT IN ('THU_QUYET_TOAN','HOAN_COC','HOAN_TIEN_THUE')) OR (MaQuyetToan IS NOT NULL AND LoaiThanhToan IN ('THU_QUYET_TOAN','HOAN_COC','HOAN_TIEN_THUE')))) OR (MaDoiSoatHuyHopDong IS NOT NULL AND MaDoiSoatHuyHopDong=MaHopDong AND MaQuyetToan IS NULL AND LoaiThanhToan IN ('HOAN_COC','HOAN_TIEN_THUE','HOAN_THU_THUA'))

index_filters.definition: Email IS NOT NULL AND EmailXacMinhLucUtc IS NOT NULL
